entities.summary: Dialogue – The Greens' Party, in short Párbeszéd or Párbeszéd – Zöldek, is a green political party in Hungary that was formed in February 2013 by eight MPs who left the Politics Can Be Different (LMP) party. Since its foundation, the party has never independently participated in any election. In 2026, the party decided not to participate in the parliamentary election at all.
